name: Belladonna
body:
Price 100 gp; Weight —

DETAILS

Type poison (ingested); Save Fortitude DC 14; Onset 10 minutes; Frequency 1/minute for 6 minutes; Cure 1 save

EFFECT

1d2 Str damage, target can attempt one save to cure a lycanthropy affliction contracted in the past hour.
